metadata.name: Family Game Night
metadata.author: Example Modder
metadata.description: Host a family game night to build rapport with multiple family members at once. Creates bonding opportunities and can be used to subtly plant suggestions during relaxed moments.

activity_data.name: Host Family Game Night
activity_data.description: Gather the family for board games and fun. Everyone participates, creating a relaxed atmosphere perfect for bonding... or manipulation.

special_mechanics.description: During relaxed game play, participants are more receptive to subtle suggestions

dialogue.start: You suggest a family game night. Everyone seems interested!

positive: Everyone's laughing and having a great time!
Tom: 'We should do this more often.'
during.phs_opportunity: During a quiet moment between rounds, you lean in close to {target}...
during.high_tension: The competitive spirit is making things a bit tense...

end.success: What a great evening! Everyone had fun and feels closer to you.
end.phs_success: You successfully planted a suggestion during the relaxed atmosphere. No one noticed.
end.phs_caught: {observer} gives you a strange look. Did they notice something odd?
end.partial: The game night was fun, but not everyone participated fully.

outcomes.message: The night was such a success that game nights might become a family tradition!
